items.html: And behold, Moshe Rabbeinu too was included in Adam, by the secret of "What is his name, and what is the name of his son, if you know?" — Adam, Hevel. And when Moshe merited them and corrected them, certainly Adam HaRishon himself was completed and corrected through them. And it is known that Moshe is the choicest of all creatures; therefore he corrected the flaw of Adam HaRishon, which no other righteous person in the world corrected.
